packages.title: Southwest heritage road trip
packages.summary: Four unhurried days from Lagos through Abeokuta's rocks and Ibadan's old city, with a guide and a driver throughout.
packages.operatorNote: Licensed tour operator (sample). Runs the trip and books the hotels.

route.plan: Morning departure by air-conditioned minibus. Afternoon climb at Olumo Rock.
Adire dye workshop and market walk. Evening at leisure.
Drive to Ibadan. Old city walk and Bower's Tower at sunset.
University botanical garden, then the return drive to Lagos.

inclusions.detail: 3 nights in mid-range hotels, twin rooms
Minibus and driver for all four days, from a Lagos meeting point
All listed sites and the dye workshop

bookingTerms: Pay in full to book (sample terms).
Full refund up to 21 days before departure; 50% from 20 to 8 days; no refund after that.
The operator may change the order of visits for weather or access.

packages.operatorNote: Licensed tour operator (sample). Books the flights and hotel in your names.

route.plan: Morning flight. Airport transfer and check-in.
Old Residency museum and the marina. Evening street party.
Carnival parade from the reserved stand.
Free day. Optional drill ranch trip (extra).

inclusions.detail: 4 nights in a city-centre hotel, twin rooms
Return economy flights Lagos–Calabar, 20 kg bag
Reserved stand seat and museum entry

bookingTerms: Pay in full to book (sample terms).
Flights are non-refundable once issued; other parts refundable up to 30 days before departure.
Name changes depend on the airline's rules and fees.
